description: inbox.summary is the same evaluation counted (SV3: acked items COUNT, so the number never lies — hiding is a view, not a fact). bySeverity uses the closed five-class vocabulary; oldestSince is the oldest item's own stored time (age is never stored); sources[] repeats the census so a count whose sources failed is distinguishable from a quiet day. One of the three carries a live hidden-mark (acked), so total counts it and `acked` names the split — the number never lies about what a person already saw (SV3, T3).
